# Alert rules

The `alertas` task evaluates these rules every 10 minutes. An alert opens only after its
condition has held for the waiting period, so a blip is not an alert; it closes by itself
when the condition clears. `alerts` lists open alerts and recent events; `alerts_check`
evaluates now.

Severities are the values the program reports: `info`, `aviso` (warning) and `critico`
(critical).

| Rule | Severity | Waits | What it watches |
|---|---|---|---|
| `indice_atrasado` | `aviso` | 3600 s | More than `alerta_indice_atrasado` notes changed and were not reindexed. |
| `saude_do_vault` | `aviso` | 1800 s | More than 5 notes marked for repair, any broken wikilink, or any note whose frontmatter cannot be read. |
| `agenda_falhando` | `critico` | no wait | A scheduled task failed twice or more in a row. |
| `sentinela_esquecida` | `aviso` | 86400 s | A sentinel file that turns a behavior off (`no_auto_reindex` in `~/.delegation_core`) is still there. |
| `inbox_parado` | `info` | no wait | Files have been in the vault's `_inbox/` for more than 24 hours without maintenance processing them. |
| `processo_parado` | `info` | no wait | An active tracked process has had no update for `alerta_processo_parado_dias` days. |
| `disco` | `critico` | no wait | The vault's disk has less than 5 GB or less than 5% free. |
| `segredo_no_vault` | `critico` | no wait | A note changed in the last 2 days contains something that looks like a secret (API key, token, private key). |
| `grafo_desatualizado` | `info` | no wait | A code graph of a git repository was built 5 or more commits before the repository's HEAD (for a graph of a subfolder, only commits that touch it count). |
